faces.name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever you scry or surveil, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.

faces.name: Saheeli, Filigree Master
faces.oracleText:
+1: Scry 1. You may tap an untapped artifact you control. If you do, draw a card.
−2: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying. They gain haste until end of turn.
−4: You get an emblem with "Artifact creatures you control get +1/+1" and "Artifact spells you cast cost {1} less to cast."

faces.name: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar
faces.oracleText:
Thopters you control have haste.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.

faces.name: Saheeli, Poet's Muse
faces.oracleText:
Dinobots — Saheeli, Poet's Muse can be your commander. If she is, a Huatli card can also be your commander.
+1: Create a blue Note artifact token with "When this token leaves the battlefield, put two loyalty counters on a Huatli planeswalker you control."
−1: Sacrifice a Note. If you do, draw two cards.
−8: Create five 3/3 Dinosaur artifact creature tokens.

faces.name: Saheeli, Radiant Creator
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you cast an Artificer or artifact spell, you get {E} (an energy counter).
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {E}{E}{E}. When you do, create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control, except it's a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

faces.name: Saheeli Rai
faces.oracleText:
+1: Scry 1. Saheeli Rai deals 1 damage to each opponent.
−2: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types. That token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
−7: Search your library for up to three artifact cards with different names, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

faces.name: Saheeli's Artistry
faces.oracleText:
Choose one or both —
• Create a token that's a copy of target artifact.
• Create a token that's a copy of target creature, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.

faces.name: Saheeli's Directive
faces.oracleText:
Improvise (Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)
Reveal the top X cards of your library. You may put any number of artifact cards with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield. Then put all cards revealed this way that weren't put onto the battlefield into your graveyard.
